=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:parse_tests_file, `line = raw.strip()` before `_TESTS_FILE_CONTROL_RE.search(line)` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `str.strip()` removes leading/trailing control characters (\t, \v, \f, \r, \x1c-\x1f) before the control-character check, so "tests/test_ok.py\x1f" or "\x0ctests/test_ok.py" is normalised and run instead of being rejected with tests_file_control_character; mid-line control characters are still rejected, and there is no path-escape impact.
  WHY: The documented agents.d contract is not met; fix: run the check on raw.rstrip("\r").
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:228-240 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The .github/ai overlay is still in the working tree even though the entry[1]/entry[2] editor summaries say it was removed; it has no --tests-file gate and runs for every caller (scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh).
  WHY: Every caller gets a different /source snapshot and a new snapshot_failed abort path at line 237, which breaks "Existing callers and the default path are unchanged" and makes the changelog and agents.d text untrue; the gate still lists tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py as caused; fix: delete lines 228-240.
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:855, 862, 870-871 (test_wrapper_lists_uncommitted_tracked_edits_and_overlays_command_inputs) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The claimed revert of this test did not land, and the test still locks in the out-of-scope overlay.
  WHY: Without the wrapper block the test fails at line 871; with both in place, CI enforces behaviour the issue forbids.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:classify_baseline 837-842; plan_units 610-615 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The rc 4/5 exception looks at the whole merged multi-name unit, so a missing PR-added node on the baseline (exit 4) hides an inherited failure of test_old_break.
  WHY: The inherited failure is reported as caused and status "fail" triggers an unwarranted repair turn; fix: set unit["baseline_status"] = "error" for multi-target units (~4 lines).
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:classify_baseline 837-842; pr_rcs at line 828 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A named node missing on the PR tree (rc 4/5) that exists and fails on the baseline counts as inherited.
  WHY: run_gate can return "pass" for a requested test that never ran on the PR tree; it should be reported as unverified.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:228-240 (naming/back-compat) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Callers that never pass --tests-file see a different default behaviour from main (new snapshot_failed exit, different /source contents) in a module that ships to consumer repos.
  WHY: A consumer repo with an uncopyable tracked top-level .github/ai file gets an unverified snapshot_failed result on every run; same root cause as the correctness finding.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:233-239 (trust boundary) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The overlay skips the scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py filter (allowed() line 137 rejects secret/credential/.env/.pem/.key/.p12; line 152 keeps .github/ai out), with no flag gate or kill switch; the impact is limited by the read-only baseline mount.
  WHY: Test code in the container gets access to filtered .github/ai files without any declared change; fix: remove lines 228-240.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh: add --tests-file <path> ... Existing callers and the default path are unchanged." and "Stay inside the listed files, use append-only edits"
  Expected change site: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh lines 228-240 must be removed, and tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py lines 855, 862 and 870-871 reverted
  Evidence of absence: The last run diff is the single line-102 change, with no hunk removing the overlay (still at HEAD lines 228-240); the test hunk asserting label_contract.v1.json also remains.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Notes: verified the line-102 guard `[ "$#" -ge 2 ] || { synthetic_result usage_error; exit 0; }` is correct (synthetic_result at lines 78-86 logs usage_error). Not a gap: leaving the live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py untouched is acceptable (tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py lines 43-48). Hardening: the parse_tests_file control-char check before strip (2 lines); the classify_baseline multi-target baseline_status "error" fix (4 lines); HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
